rubric.aligned: All six game-joint neighborhoods appear on the corresponding visible body parts in the source/overlay pair.
rubric.uncertain: Occluded, stylized, cropped, too small, or ambiguous left/right/viewpoint makes correctness visually unverifiable.
rubric.misaligned: At least one required joint is clearly placed off the corresponding body part.
